name: Mondrian Cannes
insider_take: Where Philippe Starck's avant-garde design meets the legendary glamour of the French Riviera in a stunning waterfront sanctuary.
whats_special: This Philippe Starck-designed masterpiece sits directly on La Croisette, featuring the designer's signature whimsical touches like oversized chess pieces and Alice in Wonderland-inspired decor. The hotel's dramatic white facade and infinity pool create an striking contrast against the Mediterranean backdrop, while its location puts you steps from the Palais des Festivals where the Cannes Film Festival unfolds each May.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors for unobstructed views of the Lérins Islands, and time your stay during the Festival de Cannes for a chance to spot A-listers in the hotel's chic lobby and poolside areas.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers 360-degree views of Cannes Bay and the Esterel Mountains, while the nearby Marché Forville (just a 5-minute walk) showcases the best Provençal produce and local specialties. The legendary Martinez Beach, accessible via the hotel's private pathway, provides exclusive cabanas and water sports with VIP service.
pros: Prime location near Palais des Festivals and La Croisette
Stylish modern design with sophisticated décor
Rooftop terrace with panoramic Mediterranean views
High-quality amenities and premium service standards
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury Cannes location
Limited parking availability in busy city center
